notes: All six required web searches ran this time, plus one more on the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (seven in total). None of them returned any statement by him about AI risk; the search restricted to taylor.house.gov returned no pages from his site at all. Do not confuse him with Rep. Warren Davidson (Ohio 8th district), who has written on AI. The 16 September 2026 press release was re-opened this session and the quote wording confirmed.
